risk_if_not_implemented: Without Vulnerability Ranking, known and exploitable vulnerabilities may remain unaddressed, giving adversaries readily available entry points. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Risk Ranking
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and assign a risk ranking to newly discovered security vulnerabilities that is based on industry-recognized practices.
compensating_control_1.justification: Risk Ranking (RSK-15) provides risk identification and prioritization that compensates for the absence of Vulnerability Ranking (VPM-05) by enabling informed decisions about where to focus resources to manage residual exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Vulnerability Remediation Process
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure that vulnerabilities are properly identified, tracked and remediated.
compensating_control_2.justification: Vulnerability Remediation Process (VPM-06) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Vulnerability Ranking (VPM-05) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
